design: Supplemental context-seeded matched comparison, chosen after exact replay and frozen before any supplemental requests. Both original seeds, both original prompt arms, same four source utterances, same settings and shared neutral two-message synthetic prior context. This is a distinct engineering diagnostic and preserves the old and replayed blank cells.

有点阳光的时候，坐一会儿挺舒服。

sharedHistoryDigestEncoding: UTF-8 JSON with literal Unicode, comma-space and colon-space separators, no trailing newline

armOrder: Alternate legacy/current and current/legacy by seed index plus 1-based turn
